question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：南非 vs 韩国（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: South Africa vs Korea Republic (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 241 分使韩国约六成占优，但第三轮轮换不确定性让南非爆冷加逼平合计仍近四成。
one_liner_en: A 241-point Elo gap gives Korea Republic roughly a 60% edge, though matchday-3 rotation uncertainty keeps South Africa's combined upset-or-draw chance near 40%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 241 分（韩国 1758 / 第 33 vs 南非 1517 / 第 80），是基准概率的主导因素。
key_reasons.en: 241-point Elo gap (Korea 1758 / rank 33 vs South Africa 1517 / rank 80) dominates the baseline probabilities.

key_reasons.cn: 韩国中场黄仁范带踝伤隐患入选，中卫曹侑珉伤退由赵渭济顶替，阵容深度小幅受损。
key_reasons.en: Korea midfielder Hwang In-beom was selected despite an ankle concern and centre-back Cho Yu-min withdrew injured (replaced by Cho Wi-je), slightly denting squad depth.

key_reasons.cn: 南非除已恢复合练的 Modiba 外无重大伤情，且双方三场小组赛都在墨西哥，环境适应度对等。
key_reasons.en: South Africa has no major absences (Modiba back in full training), and both sides play all group games in Mexico, so acclimatization is symmetric.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neither team is a host) gives p_stat 0.156/0.219/0.625; bounded evidence adjustment of 2pp total (Korea −2pp toward SA win and draw) then renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6–0.8 sensitivity plus thin evidence and unknown matchday-3 stakes.
